dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. How much is this dress?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ɪz ðɪs ˈdrɛs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's one thousand two hundred ninety baht.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈwʌn ˈθaʊzənd ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd ˈnaɪnti ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Can I pay by card?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. kən aɪ ˈpeɪ baɪ ˈkɑːrd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure. That's one thousand three hundred seventy baht.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ðæts ˈwʌn ˈθaʊzənd ˈθriː ˈhʌndrəd ˈsɛvənti ˈbɑːt.
